facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 当前通过 SOSV Startup Development Programs 统一申请。Founder需说明团队、技术、可服务市场、竞争格局，以及在 SOSV program 中的 technical development plan；通过初筛后进入标准 diligence calls。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 强 scientific/technical founder；明确实验/研发里程碑；足够 runway；可利用实验室/biotech operator support。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: IndieBio legacy program 已纳入 SOSV SF / SOSV NY current model；实际 residency/lab participation 依所选 location，属于强线下型深科技项目。
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes — SOSV reports globally sourced founders; practical US attendance eligibility required
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 需根据 SF/NY residency 自行满足赴美条件；官方 application FAQ 未承诺统一 visa sponsorship。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 10–15分钟 pitch materials；团队、技术、market、竞争、technical development plan；后续 diligence。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: SOSV application portal；可同时申请 HAX / IndieBio 类项目。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio；阶段以 Pre-seed–seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：应逐步用 SOSV SF / SOSV NY 替代旧 IndieBio 品牌展示；数据库保留 legacy record 方便历史检索。

facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Apply through SOSV Startup Development Programs with team, technology, addressable market, competition and a technical development plan. Initial screening is followed by due-diligence calls.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Strong scientific or technical founders, clear R&D milestones, sufficient runway and a need for laboratory or biotech operational support.
facts.On-site / Attendance: The legacy IndieBio program is now part of SOSV SF and SOSV NY. Residency and laboratory participation depend on location; in-person engagement is central.
facts.International Founder: Yes — SOSV reports globally sourced founders; practical US attendance eligibility required
facts.Visa / Relocation: Participants must meet entry requirements for SF or NYC residency; the official application FAQ does not promise standard visa sponsorship.
facts.Application Materials: A 10–15 minute pitch covering the team, technology, market, competition and technical development plan, followed by due diligence.
facts.Public Contact Route: SOSV application portal; applicants may apply to programs such as HAX and IndieBio.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio; primarily at the Pre-seed–seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses
facts.Notes: Use SOSV SF and SOSV NY for the current offering. The IndieBio entry is retained for historical reference.
